definitions.gloss: street corner; corner of a town
definitions.explanation: A corner where streets meet in an urban area. Also used more broadly to mean 'around town' or 'in the streets,' suggesting an everyday urban setting.

examples.japanese: {街角|まちかど}でばったり{友人|ゆうじん}に{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I bumped into a friend on the street corner.

examples.japanese: {街角|まちかど}のカフェでコーヒーを{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: I had coffee at a café on the corner.

examples.japanese: {街角|まちかど}インタビューで{市民|しみん}の{声|こえ}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: We gathered citizens' opinions through street-corner interviews.

notes:
USAGE:
{街角|まちかど} evokes a casual, everyday urban atmosphere. It often appears in descriptions of chance encounters, street scenes, and public spaces. Composed of {街|まち} (town/street) + {角|かど} (corner).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街角|まちかど}のカフェ (a corner café)
- {街角|まちかど}インタビュー (street-corner interview — vox pop)
- {街角|まちかど}で{見|み}かける (to spot around town)
- {街角|まちかど}{風景|ふうけい} (street-corner scenery)
